intro
This is Shadow. Learn any dance, from any video.
problem
Learning choreography from a video means pausing, rewinding, and guessing. Nobody tells you what's wrong on this attempt.
upload
Upload any dance video. Shadow finds the beat, cuts the routine into eight-counts, and names the moves. No music? It finds the rhythm in the movement.
plan
Then it builds your lesson plan. Learn each eight-count on its own, join them up at checkpoints, and earn bronze, silver and gold as you reach full speed.
practice
Now you dance. The original video plays beside your camera, a 3D ghost dancer guides you, and your limbs turn green, amber or red.
murder

Small slips are fine. But keep getting it wrong, and the crows start to gather. Just a crow. An attempted murder. And at three... it's a murder! Shadow stops, shows you exactly what to fix, and carries on the moment you match the pose.
voice
Talk to it, hands-free. Say slower, and it slows down instantly. Ask how to fix your arms, and the coach answers out loud, then acts on it.
progress
Every eight-count is a rep. Shadow tracks your mastery, brings moves back before you forget them, and spots your habits across every routine.
tech

Under the hood, pose tracking runs in your browser, so your video never leaves your device. Gemini plans and coaches. ElevenLabs gives it a voice. Tiger Data stores every rep as time series. And Clerk keeps it yours.
outro
Shadow. You shadow the dancer, move for move. The crows are watching too.
